title: devx SDK daily scratchpad - doc gaps, sample apps & tutorial fixes
content:
Daily scratchpad (Alex) - 2026-03-06

Morning notes:
- Quick triage on SDK bug reports from yesterday. Two main themes: (1) streaming examples out-of-sync with new response shape, (2) auth example using deprecated env var.
- Standup action: confirm rollout window for docs update (product said 'next week' but need exact date).

Top priorities:
1) Docs: streaming API examples
   - Issue: current streaming example in getting-started uses onmessage framing that no longer matches runtime output. Causes confusing behavior in web samples (hangs waiting for terminator).
   - TODO: Replace example with code that listens for data events and parses chunked JSON lines; include both fetch-based and WebSocket examples.
   - Quick patch: add note at top of page: "If using runtime >= v2.8, use the chunked JSON example below."
   - Owner: Alex (draft), review: Samantha

2) Auth examples inconsistency
   - Problem: some sample apps show REDWOOD_API_KEY while new guidance is REDWOOD_TOKEN or ephemeral sessions.
   - Action: update all sample apps (node, python, go) and add a migration note.
   - Checklist: run automated sample test for each language after changes.
   - Owner: Mikaela (samples), Alex (docs)

3) New sample app: "embeddings + semantic search" starter
   - Goal: provide a minimal full-stack example: ingest small product catalog, compute embeddings, index locally (FAISS or simple in-memory), and demo search UI with highlighted matches.
   - Gaps: no TS/Next example that uses streaming for search suggestions. Need small dataset + seed script.
   - MVP tasks: seed script (python), embeddings pipeline (node), simple frontend (Next.js) that queries serverless API route.
   - Priority: high for Q2 content push.

4) Tutorials: notebook vs CLI parity
   - Observed mismatch between the tutorial notebook (colab) and the CLI quickstart. People following both get different default params (temperature, max_tokens).
   - Action: standardize defaults and add a short note on reasoning (reproducibility vs demos).

Small fixes / quick wins:
- Add note in release notes for v2.8 about changed streaming framing.
- Update 'rate limiting' doc link that currently points to old Confluence anchor.
- Add error handling snippet for common 401 case in SDK README.
- Patch the Go sample: decoder import path changed after refactor (breaks build).

Questions / unknowns:
- Is there a plan to deprecate REDWOOD_API_KEY env var? Product/Platform to confirm (asked on #product-docs).
- Which team owns the embeddings starter (is this marketing + devx or solely devx)? Need headcount/effort estimate.

Notes to self:
- Draft streaming example tonight, push PR and add a temporary banner on doc page.
- Pair with Samantha on the auth migration note; set 30-min sync at 11:30am.
- Create GH issue checklist template for sample app updates (languages, ci test, docs).

Links to reference:
- streaming discussion thread: https://slack.redwood.com/devx/streaming (thread pinned)
- broken sample PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/408
- internal playbook: confluence:devx-sdk-getting-started

End of notes.

----
Recent edits:
- 2026-03-06 09:10: added migration checklist for auth examples.
- 2026-03-06 09:45: flagged embeddings starter as Q2 priority and noted required languages.

Todo (quick view):
- [ ] Draft streaming example + tests (Alex)
- [ ] Update all sample apps for auth var (Mikaela)
- [ ] Open GH issue for embeddings starter + assign (Alex)
- [ ] Confirm deprecation plan for REDWOOD_API_KEY (ask Product)
- [ ] Standardize defaults across notebook & CLI (pair with Devon)
